watch.en: Sweat the vegetables in butter or fat first, then add the liquid.
watch.de: Das Gemüse zuerst in Butter oder Fett anschwitzen, dann die Flüssigkeit zugeben.

why.en: Hard vegetables are usually sweated in butter without letting them take on colour before the liquid goes in.
why.de: Festes Gemüse wird meist in Butter angeschwitzt, ohne dass es Farbe annimmt, bevor die Flüssigkeit dazukommt.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Sweat long -cooking vegetables in butter or fat. Add the appropriate stock or broth and bring to a simmer.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Hard vegetables are usually sweated in butter without browning before the liquid is incorporated.
